source.author: Helen McLoughlin
source.title: Family Advent Customs
source.note: Original 1954 pamphlet was 36 pages; online full text contains ZIP codes in endnotes, evidence of later update or compilation. Line locators refer to EWTN rendition, not first-edition printed pages.

source_reuse_warning: The booklet acknowledges quoting Francis X. Weiser and recipes from Florence Berger. A mention is independent author testimony only where this source supplies personal/new details; derivative material is NOT independent corroboration of Weiser. No prayers, recipes or hymn lyrics reproduced.
